Greve is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regional Clinical Quality Improvement Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report serves as a vital benchmarking tool for the Danish healthcare system, analyzing clinical quality across all 98 municipalities using data from the National Patient Registry (LPR) and DanStroke [^src1]. Specifically, Greve's data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is included in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence consists of a single tabular entry on page 94, no further narrative details, specific performance claims, or relationships regarding Greve are documented in this corpus [^src1].
